posts.name: Matt Cole
posts.text:
The day DOGE ended was the day to stop believing the myth that future returns of Bitcoin will be less than historical returns.

At that moment, the debt crisis became terminal.

The below chart captures well where I believe we are with Bitcoin & where we go from here. https://t.co/Mw96bvuRlL https://t.co/iajAVtIM79
posts.textZh:
DOGE 结束的那天，就是该停止相信「比特币未来回报会低于历史回报」这一迷思的日子。

从那一刻起，债务危机已进入终局。

下面这张图很好地刻画了我认为比特币现在所处的位置，以及接下来会去向哪里。
